title: Interventional Imaging Facilities — Minimum Requirements
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 36) — see the common all-institutions module; not repeated as items here. The manual lists 'Patient prep, holding, and recovery area or room' as a bare label bullet immediately followed by its substantive requirement bullet; the two are captured as the single item INT-008.

items.requirement: Interventional Radiology (IR) can be performed only in hospital based diagnostic setting.

The IR and/or cardiac catheterization laboratory is normally located in a separate suite, but any location in the diagnostic imaging area can be permitted provided the appropriate sterile environment is provided.
items.alternatives: any location in the diagnostic imaging area is permitted provided the appropriate sterile environment is provided

items.requirement: The number of procedure rooms shall be based on expected utilization.
The procedure room shall be a minimum of 38 square meters exclusive of fixed cabinets and shelves.

measurement.dimension: procedure room floor area exclusive of fixed cabinets and shelves

items.requirement: Prep, holding, and recovery rooms: the size of the prep, holding, and recovery areas shall be based on expected utilization.

Electrophysiology labs: if electrophysiology labs are also provided in accordance with the approved functional program, these labs may be located within and integral to the catheterization suite or located in a separate functional area proximate to the cardiac care unit.
items.applicability: if electrophysiology labs are also provided in accordance with the approved functional program
items.alternatives: may be located within and integral to the catheterization suite, or in a separate functional area proximate to the cardiac care unit

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: Scrub facilities with hands-free operable controls shall be provided adjacent to the entrance of procedure rooms, and shall be arranged to minimize incidental splatter on nearby personnel, medical equipment, or supplies.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: A patient preparation, holding, and recovery area or room shall be provided and arranged to provide visual observation before and after the procedure.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: Control room or area: a control room or area shall be provided and shall be large enough to contain and provide for the efficient functioning of the X-ray and image recording equipment.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: A view window permitting full view of the patient from the control console shall be provided.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: Electrical equipment room: an equipment room or enclosure large enough to contain X-ray transformers, power modules, and associated electronics and electrical gear shall be provided.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: Viewing room: a viewing room shall be available for use by the cardiac catheterization suite.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: A clean workroom or clean supply room shall be provided.
items.alternatives: clean workroom or clean supply room

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: A soiled workroom shall be provided.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab
items.requirement: Film file room shall be available for use by the cardiac catheterization suite.

items.section: Support areas for the IR suite / cardiac catheterization lab

items.requirement: Support areas for staff clothing and change area(s) shall be provided and arranged to ensure a traffic pattern so that personnel can enter from outside the suite, change their clothing, and move directly into the cardiac catheterization suite.
